posts.title: New photos from Gothic Basic, Gothic Peak, and Del Campo
posts.description: Yesterday I hiked Gothic Peak and Del Campo, it was a good time. Enjoy some photos.

posts.title: New photos from Semiahmoo
posts.description: Good morning! I come bearing a new 360 and plenty of new photos from Semiahmoo, WA . I got a spectacular sunset during a low tide and it was wonderful. You can see Vancouver in some of the photos.

posts.title: Smooth Scrolling with Engineer Bo's dial
posts.description: I have created an app for MacOS that intercepts the discrete, line scroll values from the device and outputs pure pixel scroll data. It has sensitivity adjustment and a filter to choose which devices to apply the smoothing to.
